title: Constraint Decay: The Fragility of LLM Agents in Backend Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2605.06445v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents demonstrate strong performance in autonomous code generation under loose specifications. However, production-grade software requires strict adherence to structural constraints, such as architectural patterns, databases, and object-relational mappings. Existing benchmarks often overlook these non-functional requirements, rewarding functionally correct but structurally arbitrary solutions. We present a systematic study evaluating how well agents handle structural constraints in multi-file backend generation. By fixing a unified API contract across 80 greenfield generation tasks and 20 feature-implementation tasks spanning eight web frameworks, we isolate the effect of structural complexity using a dual evaluation with end-to-end behavioral tests and static verifiers. translated_title: 约束衰减：LLM智能体在后端代码生成中的脆弱性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在宽松规范下的自主代码生成任务中表现出强大的性能。然而，生产级软件需要严格遵守结构性约束，例如架构模式、数据库和对象关系映射（ORM）。现有的基准测试往往忽视这些非功能性需求，奖励那些功能正确但结构随意的解决方案。我们提出了一项系统性研究，评估智能体在多文件后端代码生成中处理结构性约束的能力。通过在涵盖八个Web框架的80个全新项目生成任务和20个功能实现任务中固定统一的API契约，我们采用端到端行为测试与静态验证器相结合的双重评估方法，以隔离结构复杂性的影响。我们的发现揭示了一种“约束衰减”现象：随着结构性需求的不断累积，智能体的性能表现出显著的下降。
tldr: 该论文通过在八个Web框架上共100个后端代码生成任务的系统性评估，首次揭示了“约束衰减”现象——随着架构模式、数据库、ORM等结构性约束的累积，LLM智能体的代码生成性能会显著下降。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates LLM agents across 100 backend code generation tasks spanning eight web frameworks, revealing a novel "constraint decay" phenomenon where agent performance significantly degrades as structural constraints such as architectural patterns, databases, and ORM requirements accumulate.
